thesis: Genie is the camera crew; the cut does the changing. One short shot per spoken line, each a different place, cut on his words. The same four men and the same three objects are written identically into every shot.
lock: Afrofuturist Atlantis: a Black harbour city that kept its flood, mended in white ceramic seamed with soft light. Photographic, warm tungsten bulbs against cool dusk, gentle film grain. IN EVERY SHOT: a string of warm picnic bulbs hangs somewhere in frame, and white ceramic with glowing seams appears somewhere in frame. THE FOUR MEN, always together, all Black men in their fifties: (1) the poet, close-cropped greying hair and short beard, matte black mock-neck long sleeve and black trousers; (2) shaved head, rust-orange corduroy jacket over a white tee; (3) grey locs tied back, sky-blue linen shirt with rolled sleeves; (4) flat cap, green football jersey. Each carries a small glass hourglass whose sand glows like embers.

shots.place: Evening inside a white ceramic temple hall with timber rafters and a hand-painted WELCOME HOME banner.
shots.action: The four men pull each other into one big laughing hug in the middle of the hall.
shots.camera: Chest height, close, slowly circling them.

shots.action: The four men throw their heads back laughing; a warm light pulses in each of their chests at the same moment.
shots.camera: Tight on faces and chests, handheld, shallow focus.

shots.place: A dim, dusty back room with rows of empty wooden chairs and one tall window.
shots.action: The four men stand still in the doorway looking in, each holding up his glowing hourglass; the only light is the embers.
shots.camera: Wide and still from inside the room, the men small in the doorway.

shots.place: The edge of a forest at blue dusk, huge old trees, mist between the trunks.
shots.action: The four men walk among the trees and each lays a hand flat on a trunk as he passes.
shots.camera: Low, tracking beside them along the trunks.

shots.place: A meadow in front of the white temple at golden hour.
shots.action: The four men stand shoulder to shoulder facing us, arms around each other, grinning as if for a photograph.
shots.camera: Frontal, still, full bodies in frame.

shots.place: A sandy path through dune grass down to the shore, last light.
shots.action: The four men stand in a line; each one presses his ear to the chest of the next man and listens with eyes closed.
shots.camera: Profile, sliding slowly down the line.

shots.place: A high ridge path above a deep canyon at night under a sky crowded with stars; far below, city lights.
shots.action: The four men walk single file along the ridge away from us, their hourglasses glowing like lanterns.
shots.camera: Behind them at eye level, following.

shots.place: A wide meadow at sunset, long grass, low sun.
shots.action: The man in the green jersey throws a football in a high arc; the other three run laughing to catch it.
shots.camera: Wide, the ball crossing the sun.

shots.place: Dusk. A small white house at the top of the meadow with its porch light on.
shots.action: The four men walk up toward the lit porch side by side with their backs to us.
shots.camera: Behind them at eye level, following.
